2.175.19
LinearScale.ScaleRanges
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The LinearScale.ScaleRanges element specifies ranges to display on a LinearScale. This element is
optional. This element is of type ScaleRanges.
The following is the parent element of the LinearScale.ScaleRanges element.
Parent elements
LinearScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the LinearScale.ScaleRanges element.
 <xsd:element name="ScaleRanges" type="ScaleRangesType" minOccurs="0" />
